plain: Extending contextual integrity from personal information to everything an agent does, so actions must fit the norms of the setting.
eli5: Not only keeping secrets in the right place, but doing every job in the way that fits where you are.
technical: The agentic-privacy report's extension of CI to all behaviour: enforcing actions appropriate to a context's purposes, so a system that faithfully enforces its own specification is still contextually insecure if that specification violates social norms.
